narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three in a row hold a multiple of three, but they are not always a multiple of six.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Four times five times six is one hundred and twenty, and three times four times five is sixty.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each run of three also holds an even number, so both results have a two and a three.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, multiply any four dates in a row and divide the result by twenty four.
